profile.rubric: product truth, game-loop depth, rendered-pixel accessibility, release honesty, and session continuity
profile.staging: No deployment was authorized or attempted; all release gates remain independent.
profile.source: Live S99 review of S97 and S98 changes

gameLoopReview.evidence: The first-season and chronology fixes remain correct. Residual tie handling contradicted the same record-truth authority in sentiment, deadline posture, marquee ranking, legacy scoring, mastery evidence, and newsletter copy; retention remains evidence-limited without an opted-in cohort.

feature-depth.evidence: Six downstream systems still ignored ties or displayed a two-column career record after S97 established a shared tie-aware authority.
Creative direction still reserves the terminal ending for founder direction.

new-innovative-features.evidence: A consumer allowlist can catch new manual record math before it fragments the established authority.
A compact deterministic multi-season fixture could jointly exercise ties, chronology, and payoff without adding a provider.

ui-ux.evidence: Escape and scrim closed and made the drawer inert without returning focus, leaving focus inside an unavailable subtree or on the body.
The existing scrollable 768px drawer rendered cleanly; the defect was dismissal focus, not structure.

feedback-loop.candidate: fan sentiment distinguishes ties from losses
feedback-loop.evidence: A tied game emitted the explicit reason ‘lost this week’.
No genuine opted-in cohort exists, so aggregate loads cannot establish player behavior.

gamification-engagement.candidate: career score and mastery count ties as half-wins
gamification-engagement.evidence: GM legacy omitted total ties and career win percentage divided only wins by wins plus losses.
Mastery is explicitly descriptive and must not invent causal bonuses.

ai-integration.evidence: An AST or source sentinel can flag manual W/L arithmetic cheaply and explain the shared replacement.
No reproduced defect requires variable-cost inference or a new data boundary.

security.evidence: Focus inside an inert subtree is an accessibility and browser-state integrity defect, reproduced on Escape and scrim dismissal.
External Obelisk remains the declared identity architecture and no local account flow is authorized.

speed-organization-efficiency.candidate: monotonic session identity and truthful startup receipts
speed-organization-efficiency.evidence: The local lock omitted session_id and trigger, --help mutated state, and string summaries rendered blank Tests and Deploy rows despite structured verification data.
Deriving deployability from the artifact manifest would reduce long-term reliance on a growing path allowlist.

token-api-reduction.candidate: shared record helpers and local browser proof
token-api-reduction.evidence: All fixes reuse deterministic local authorities and existing browser infrastructure with no runtime API cost.
It would add cost and data access without resolving any reproduced defect.

items.category: Feature depth · feedback loop · gamification truth
items.title: Tie-aware record truth stopped before sentiment, trade posture, marquee ranking, and the persistent General Manager career
items.premise: S97 added shared tie-aware helpers, but fan sentiment divided by wins plus losses, ties were narrated as losses, trade and marquee fallbacks counted a tie as zero wins, and GM legacy omitted ties from persistence, scoring, mastery, and newsletter output.

premises.claim: fan sentiment consumes the engine record authority
browser record consumers use the shared authority

items.fix: Route every residual calculation and narrative through the existing engine/browser record helpers, migrate older saves to zero ties, persist season/career ties, and bind half-win thresholds with focused tests.

L1.recipe: Correct the three visible W/L/T formulas and the tie-versus-loss reason.

L2.recipe: Use both shared helpers across every named consumer and add exact threshold tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus migrate persistent legacy ties, expose tie-complete career and mastery copy, and expand the consumer sentinel.

items.executionEvidence: The focused 114/114 Node proof and final canonical 1,313/1,313 suite pass. A 5-3-2 team is a .600 buyer, 5-4-1 fan approval is .550-derived, ties narrate as ties, marquee fallback selects the true leader, and an 8-8-1 legacy returns record 8-8-1 at .500.

items.title: Escape and scrim dismissal could strand focus inside the newly inert tablet drawer
items.premise: S98 restored focus only from the tab-selection path. Escape invoked closeNav directly while focus remained on a drawer tab; pointer-down on the scrim could move focus before click, so both paths needed explicit close semantics.

premises.claim: focus restoration happens before inert is applied

items.fix: Centralize restore-before-inert behavior in closeNav, allow explicit restoration for pointer and Escape paths, retain automatic restoration when focus is inside the drawer, and prove it in Playwright plus rendered pixels.

L1.recipe: Focus the toggle from the Escape listener.

L2.recipe: Centralize restore-before-inert and cover Escape plus scrim.

L3.recipe: L2 plus real-browser assertions and dark/light desktop, tablet, and mobile pixel receipts.

items.executionEvidence: The targeted journey and full Playwright suite pass 55/55; Escape and scrim both close the drawer and focus the visible toggle. Eight source-hash-bound captures were manually reviewed, and CANON-053 reports 8 hash-bound captures across two themes with zero open defects.

items.title: The release reconciler told the next session to re-prove staging and revision gates that were already green
items.premise: releaseTruthProse hard-coded every possible release gate into nextMilestone. Current structured evidence had independent staging and exact revision verified, while PROJECT_STATUS still instructed the next session to verify both.

premises.claim: next milestone is derived from pending gates

items.fix: Build nextMilestone from only freshness and gate fields that are not verified, keep launch HOLD independent, and reconcile current status from the exact S98 launch-evidence receipt.

L1.recipe: Remove staging and revision from the current prose by hand.

L2.recipe: Derive milestone clauses from each structured gate and add a regression test.

L3.recipe: L2 plus re-run the reconciler against the exact receipt and prove HOLD still names only email, approval, and lifecycle.

items.executionEvidence: Release-truth tests pass and PROJECT_STATUS now omits already-proven staging/revision work while retaining HOLD for on-domain email/reply identity, SHA-bound founder approval, and lifecycle authority.

items.title: The local session lock could not identify S98/S99 correctly and the startup/closeout receipts degraded
items.premise: The local writer silently ignored --trigger, omitted session_id, and mutated the lock on --help. The prior closeout then fell back out-of-band, lastCloseoutAt stayed stale, its proof line reported 213 files and +0/-0, and the next startup printed blank Tests and Deploy rows despite lastVerification.

premises.claim: lock writes the active session id
startup string summaries accept verification receipts

items.fix: Propagate the monotonic session resolver and non-mutating help/trigger contract, regenerate the active S99 lock, render existing verification receipts in startup, and repair the measured S98 closeout/status fields.

L1.recipe: Add session_id to the current lock and repair the two stale fields.

L2.recipe: Propagate the resolver and writer contract, add tests, and feed lastVerification into startup rendering.

L3.recipe: L2 plus repair the prior diff receipt, verify --help writes nothing, and send the cross-repo protocol drift through Studio Ark.

items.executionEvidence: The active lock now says session_id 99 and founder-mission; --help preserves its SHA-256; session identity/startup tests pass; startup summaries render current test and verified production receipts instead of blanks or N/A; S98 proof is repaired to the measured full-session 236 files, +5,724/-547; and lastCloseoutAt is bound to the final S98 commit timestamp.

phantomsRejected.evidence: The transition predicate and exactly-once callback controls remain green.
The runtime preserves year/week-descending receipts and focused chronology tests pass.
Email reply identity, founder approval, lifecycle authority, external Obelisk proof, and cohort evidence remain independent.
Git diff paths are normalized repository entries; no traversal input reaches the classifier.
Rendered drawer structure is sound at the breakpoint; only close-focus semantics were defective.
The defect is deterministic arithmetic and persistence, already covered by local shared authorities.

recommendedMoves: Keep every record calculation and narrative on the shared tie-aware helpers.
Treat drawer closure as a focus-state transition before an inert-state transition.
Render release and session guidance from structured evidence instead of static prose.
Keep public launch on HOLD until its independent authorities are actually verified.
